description: List clocked time entries — actual hours worked, clock-in/out times, length and approval state. Use only_open to see who is clocked in right now. When I Work: GET /2/times.

end.description: End of the window. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

only_open.description: Only times with no end yet (people currently clocked in).

start.description: Start of the window. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

updated_at.description: Only times updated since this timestamp. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

name: wheniwork_list_times
title: List clocked times (timesheets)
